# Fit

> Resize photos for Instagram, YouTube and X in the browser. Exact pixels, presets, batch ZIP.

The public origin is https://fit-local-six.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

Do not cite https://fit-local.vercel.app — that host is not this product.

## Tools

* [Resize](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/) — Exact pixels and social presets in this tab.
* [Print size](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/print) — Paper × DPI → pixels, then the same Canvas.

## Guides

* [How to resize](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/guide) — Fill / Fit / Stretch. There is no `/how-to` URL.
* [Presets](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/presets) — Instagram, YouTube, X pixel table.
* [Instagram](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/instagram) — Feed vs story vs reel poster. Their encoder still runs.
* [YouTube](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/youtube) — Thumbnail 1280×720, not the video file.
* [Avatar](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/avatar) — Square crop; the platform paints the circle.
* [Modes](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/modes) — Fill vs Fit vs Stretch.
* [Use cases](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/use-cases) — Who should not upload a photo.
* [FAQ](https://fit-local-six.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy and limits.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API, no HEIC decoder, no `/exact` duplicate of the homepage, and no `/blogs/` cluster.
